title: TAXNMY grouping of names per publisher
description: The answer of the grouping step (TAX-26): one class per name of one publisher. Code checks it; see referee/prompt-group.md.

id.description: The id of the name in <names>, such as n3.

of.description: For alias and edition: the key of an existing product, or the id of a name classed product. For a series that is a part of one product: that product. Otherwise null.
